## Summary

Read `CONTRIBUTING.md` and the contribution-only permission in `LICENSE.md`
before preparing or submitting a change.

Explain the smallest coherent change and why it benefits readers or strengthens security.

## Scope and evidence

- Affected files or guide sections:
- Claim state: documented, observed, or requires recheck
- Primary sources and the claims they support:

## Validation

List the commands, tests, affected-edition PDF rebuilds, accessibility review,
and full-document visual inspection performed.

## Checklist

- [ ] I discussed substantial scope in an issue and read `CONTRIBUTING.md`.
- [ ] This change does not overstate certification, completeness, or universal effectiveness.
- [ ] Consequential steps retain least-privilege, warning, verification, and rollback guidance.
- [ ] I rebuilt and reviewed every affected PDF and its matching Markdown companion if generated content or layout changed.
- [ ] Shared Home and Pro instructions remain synchronized, and any edition-specific difference is documented.
- [ ] I checked links, citations, selectable text, reading order, contrast, and small text as applicable.
- [ ] I have the right to submit this material and agree to the contribution grant in `CONTRIBUTING.md`.
- [ ] I understand that the contribution-only permission does not authorize a separate release, general-purpose modified fork, commercial use, or redistribution outside this contribution process.
- [ ] No commit, branch, comment, attachment, test output, or workflow log contains secrets, personal information, system identifiers, raw diagnostics, or other sensitive evidence.

Security-sensitive changes must follow `SECURITY.md` and must not be disclosed in a public pull request. Use GitHub private vulnerability reporting when available.
